audit_items.proof_trace: Pre-Fulu epochs bypass blob parameter mixing into fork digest via early return at L576-577, causing fork_digest = f(ForkVersion, GenesisValidatorsRoot) only. Nodes with different MaxBlobsPerBlock values compute identical fork digests, violating the invariant that different blob configs must form separate networks.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker or misconfigured node sets MaxBlobsPerBlock=9 while network uses MaxBlobsPerBlock=6, both at epoch < FuluForkEpoch. Both compute identical fork digests, connect successfully via P2P (fork.go:57-63), and subscribe to same gossip topics, allowing incompatible nodes to join the network and cause consensus failures.
